# Negative experiment — not a functional example

Use a disposable local build directory and a compiler with AddressSanitizer support:

```bash
c++ -std=c++20 -g -O1 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
  source/book05/ch10/optional/unsafe.cpp -o build/unsafe-asan
ASAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 build/unsafe-asan 8
